Standardized GPR and the next quarter's change in log REER

Each chart is one emerging economy. The blue line is the average of monthly standardized GPR in quarter t, measured on the left axis. The rust line is the sum of the monthly changes in log REER in quarter t+1, measured on the right axis. Both lines are drawn on the quarter of GPR. The correlation next to the country name is the Pearson correlation of those two series.

Each pair uses a complete GPR quarter and a complete next quarter of log-REER changes. The charts run from GPR in 2000Q1 through GPR in 2023Q3. Source: cleaned/replication_cleaned/country_month.csv.
